limitations_and_boundaries: Absence of age-matched wild-type control mice prevents direct assessment of how much C3 lowering mitigated synaptic deficits and cognitive decline relative to non-amyloid mice.
Global C3 lowering in adulthood may not be safe long-term in AD patients due to infection risk; brain-specific reduction may be more favorable.
C3 lowering was not complete in the brain, which may explain the lack of major glial changes in the whole hippocampus.
The study used only male mice? (sex not explicitly stated in provided chunks).
The APP-KI model expresses physiological APP levels, limiting generalizability to overexpression models.
Behavioral tests were conducted at a single late time point (15 months); earlier or longitudinal assessments were not performed.
RNA-seq was performed only on prefrontal cortex, not hippocampus.
No functional rescue experiments (e.g., C3 add-back) were performed to confirm causality.

research_questions.statement: Does global complement C3 lowering in adult APP-KI mice after the onset of plaque deposition protect cognition and synapses?

methods.name: Tamoxifen-induced C3 knockout
